Copy explicitly forwards producer to normal and receiver-clone scratch cleanup; unbound/handed-off paths stay legacy
limitations: Stat witness does not pin leaf inode or defeat hostile inode ABA
Cooperative lookup/unlink is not atomic namespace CAS
Legacy/directory/auxiliary-family cleanup, first admission, mount incarnation, other-platform runtime, resource ceilings and crash durability remain open
